open_findings.summary: Ten provisional patterns merge 40 occurrences carrying different accepted requirement sets despite the declared exact merge key.
Six exact declared merge keys are split across two patterns; the published 498-pattern partition cannot be regenerated, while independent reconstruction yields 504 keys.

correction_order.rule: One provisional pattern per exact normalized accepted requirement set + response product + cognitive action. Empty accepted requirement sets remain separated by accepted source-pattern identity as already declared.
must_rebuild: provisional catalog IDs, definitions, examples, boundaries and counts
correction_order.protected_content: All accepted C2 source rows, locators, marks, scope, marking evidence, context/unresolved eligibility and lineage remain source-identical.
correction_order.retest: fresh independent A3 retest; A0 audit and decision required before C3b

scope_boundary: No equivalence, final pattern decision, split/holdout, glossary reconciliation, traceability, lesson, translation, app modification or Stage 3 work may start.
